releaseNote.summary: PythonTask now calls the domain's own Python runtime container from Orchestration over Dapr; Python, pythonnet and the Kubernetes client are removed from the Execution image.

migrations.title: PythonTask config moves from inline script to a handler reference
migrations.description: PythonTask (type 23) no longer carries code. config.script and config.executionMode are gone; config.handler names a handler registered in the domain's Python runtime image (built FROM ghcr.io/burgan-tech/vnext/python-runtime), config.input and config.timeoutSeconds stay, and the standard InputHandler/OutputHandler mapping now runs. The Execution host's Python section (Python:*) and its pythonNet, process and container modes are removed. The type was experimental and disabled by default; @burgan-tech/vnext-schema 0.0.59 defines the type 23 handler contract.
migrations.action: Move each Python script into a handler module of the domain's runtime image, replace config.script with config.handler, enable the runtime in the Helm chart (it sets Workflow:PythonRuntime:AppId), and drop Python:* settings from Execution overrides.

deprecations.replacement: task.type=23 config.handler (a handler registered in the domain's Python runtime image)
deprecations.message: PythonTask no longer carries inline Python. config.script and config.executionMode are rejected at publish; name a handler registered in the domain's runtime image instead (migration python-task-handler-contract). The type was experimental and disabled by default.

deprecations.path: Execution host Python:* (Python:Enabled, Python:ExecutionMode, Python:Container:*, Python:MaxTimeoutSeconds, ...)
deprecations.replacement: Helm pythonRuntime block; Orchestration Workflow:PythonRuntime:AppId / InvokeMethod / TimeoutGraceSeconds
deprecations.message: The Execution host no longer reads any Python:* setting; leftover overrides are ignored (unbound keys). Python runs in the domain's own runtime container and Orchestration calls it, configured by Workflow:PythonRuntime (set by the Helm chart when pythonRuntime is enabled). See migration python-task-handler-contract.
